s: Dine shopar shel rosh hashshana ubo k"z seipim: shopar shel rosh hashshana mitzvato sheyyihyeh kapup, kede sheyyikpepu et libbam lehaqqadosh baruk hu battepilla. Vekol hashshoparot hakkepupin kesherim chutz mishshel para veshel shor, mippene sheeno niqra shopar ella qeren, shenneemar "bekor shoro vego' veqarne reem qarnayv", vehu haddin qarne rob hachayyot shehem etzem echad veen shemam shopar, sheen niqra shopar ella qarnayim hachalulim sheyyesh lahem zakrut bipnim veniqlap gidan min hazzakrut, kegon shel kebasim veelim veizzim, ki shopar hu milleshon shepoperet, abal qarne rob hachayyot hem etzem echad upesulin apillu bediabad kemo shel para veshel shor:

Umitzva min hammubchar litqoa beshopar shel ayil kede sheyyizkor lanu aqedat yitzchaq, abal im en lo shopar shel ayil — yotze bishar minim, chutz mishshel para vekayyotze bo, vaapillu bepashut im en lo kapup, shello ameru kapup ella lekattechilla, abal bediabad im taqa bepashut — yatza, vezeh sheen lo kapup — hare zeh kediabad:
Shopar mibbehema temea yesh leposlo apillu bediabad, lepi shello huksheru limleket shamayim ella tehorim bilbad:

Haggozel shopar vetaqa bo — yatza, apillu lo nityaashu habbealim mimmennu, veeno domeh lelulab umatztza vetzitzit haggezulim, lepi shemmitzvat hashshopar eno ella hashshemia bilbad, veen bishmiat qol din gazel, shehare bishmiato eno nogea bashshopar kelal, ulepikak ap al pi shettaqa bo beissur gazel, kevan shebbeiqqar hammitzva dehaynu hashshemia en bah issur gazel — yatza yede chobato. Umikkol maqom, kevan sheal yede gazel baa hammitzva elayv — lo yebarek aleha, kedin mitzva habbaa baabera shennitbaer besiman y"a ubesiman trm"t ayyen sham:

Muttar littol shopar shel chabero shello middato litqoa bo teqia shel mitzva umebarek alayv, demin hassetam noach lo leadam sheyyaasu mitzva bemamono bedabar sheen bo chesron kis kemo shennitbaer besiman y"d ayyen sham:

Hattoqea beshopar shel aboda zara shel yisrael, kegon shehishtachava lehashshopar — lo yatza, mishshum deshopar tzarik sheyyehe bo tepach kemo sheyyitbaer, vezeh shehu omed lissarep, shehare aboda zara shel yisrael apillu im yebattelenna goy enah mebuttelet kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman ql"t, vetzarik lesorpah, vekol haomed lissarep hare hu kikbar nisrap, veim ken en bo shiur tepach: chaser

Veken haddin im hassedeq hu rachab ukeshemmedabbeqo bedebeq nikkar haddebeq ben hassedaqim, mippene shehu sotem et hechalal shebbenehem dino kesotem neqeb bedabar sheeno mimmin hashshopar shennitbaer lemala:

Nisdaq miut orek hashshopar venishar rob orko shalem velo dibbeqo bedebeq velo chibberam baur, yesh omerim sheddinam keniqqab, sheapillu lo nishtayyer missiyyum hassedeq ad meqom hannachat happeh kede shiur shopar kasher kemo shennitbaer, veyesh omerim sheeno domeh leniqqab neqeb sheyyesh bo chesron miggup hashshopar sheyyesh maqom leharuach shemmechamat hatteqia lehikkanes sham derek hachesron veyotze hachutza veeno mitchazzeq lehasdiq hashshopar, mah sheen ken besedeq sheen bo chesron miggup hashshopar veen maqom leharuach latzet sham veal ken hu mitchazzeq umasdiq hassedeq yoter vesopo lehasdiq kol orek hashshopar, ulepikak apillu im lo nisdaq ella kol shehu — pasul, lepi sheen shem shopar alayv kevan shessopo lehasdiq kullo, veim hiddeqo harbeh bechut o bimshicha — kasher, shehare hachut maamido shello yitbaqqa yoter. Uleinyan halaka, yesh lehachamir kassebara haacharona, abal bishat haddechaq sheen shopar acher matzuy yesh lismok al sebara harishona:

Nisdaq hashshopar lerochbo dehaynu sebib heqqepo, im hassedeq hu miut heqqep hashshopar venishtayyer rob heqqepo beoto maqom shalem — kasher, apillu im nishtanna qolo mikkemot shehaya qodem shennisdaq, shekkol haqqolot kesherim beshopar, vaapillu en bassedeq chesron miggup hashshopar sheen sham maqom laruach latzet, lepi sheen haruach masdiq yoter ella im ken nisdaq leorko. Abal im lo nishtayyer rob heqqepo shalem, im en mehassedeq ad meqom hannachat happeh kede shiur shopar — pasul, dekevan shennisdaq rubbo hare hu keillu nechtak kullo beoto maqom veim ken hare nechsar hashshopar mishshiuro, ulepikak ap al pi shello nishtanna qolo mikkemot shehaya qodem shennisdaq — pasul. Abal im yesh mehassedeq ad meqom hannachat happeh kede shiur shopar, ap al pi shennishtanna qolo mikkemot shehaya qodem shennisdaq — kasher. Veap al pi shehaqqol yotze derek hacheleq shellemala mehassedeq — en poselin oto mishshum qol shopar vedabar acher, o mishshum qol shene shoparot, dekevan shebbishat asiyyat hashshopar haya zeh hacheleq mechubbar leiqqar hashshopar velo niprad mimmennu leolam, laken hen nechshabin keshopar echad leinyan zeh shello leposlan mishshum shene shoparot, abal mikkol maqom enan nechshabin keshopar echad legamre kede lehashlim leshiur shopar, kevan shennisdequ venipredu zeh mizzeh berob heqqep:

Dibbeq shibre shopar zeh im zeh veasa mehem shopar echad shalem — pasul, lepi sheen zeh qaruy shopar, vaapillu yesh bashsheber shekkeneged piv shiur shopar shalem mikkol tzedadayv — ap al pi ken hu nipsal mechamat hashshebarim hannosapim al sheber zeh shehaqqol yotze derek sham, vehattora omra qol hayyotze mishshopar echad velo hayyotze mishshene shoparot:

Veken mittaam zeh im hosip kol shehu al orek hashshopar shalem beinyan shehaqqol yotze derek hattosepet hahi, ben shehattosepet mimmin hashshopar, ben sheeno mimmin hashshopar, ben shehosip batztzad haqqatzar, ben shehosip batztzad harachab — pasul, mittaam shennitbaer:

Hapako vetaqa bo — lo yatza, ben shehapako kederek shehopekin chaluq shehechezir penimiyyut hashshopar lihyot chitzoniyyuto vechitzoniyyuto lihyot penimiyyuto, ben shehinnicho kemot shehaya ella shehirchib et tzad haqqatzar shello veqitztzer et harachab berotechin vetaqa ben batztzad haqqatzar ben batztzad harachab shehaya qatzar mittechilla — lo yatza, shenneemar "vehaabarta shopar vego'", kederek haabarato shehaayil maabiro berosho mechayyim, perat lehepek. Veayyen besiman tq"tz:

Haya arok veqitztzero, im nishar bo shiur shopar — kasher. Vekamma shiur shopar — tepach, kede sheyyochazennu hattoqea beyado, dehaynu bed' etzbeotayv benonim, veyeraeh hashshopar mikkan umikkan, shehattepach hu d' etzbaot gudalin, kede shello yomru letok yado hu toqea. Vaapillu im hattoqea hu adam gadol veen hashshopar nireh mittok yado — ap al pi ken en tzarik yoter mittepach shel adam benoni dehaynu d' gudalin. Umodedin bammaqom harachab shel haggudal kemo sheyyitbaer besiman y"a. Veken haddin bekol etzbaot shebbattora:

Geredo ben mibbipnim ben mibbachutz ad sheasao daq meod kemo geled — kasher, veap al pi sheeno kederek shehaayil maabiro berosho mammash, mikkol maqom kevan shehu kederek tzemichato berosh haayil niqra kederek haabarato, velo miato ella im hapako sheshshinna oto midderek tzemichato berosh haayil:

Im hotzi hazzakrut min haqqeren veasa mimmennu shopar kegon shenniqqeb bo — pasul, lepi sheen niqra shopar ella dabar shehu chalul betibo, sheshshopar hu leshon shepoperet, vehazzakrut kevan sheeno chalul betibo — eno niqra shopar. Abal im lo hotzi hazzakrut min haqqeren ella naqab bo neqeb — kasher. Vaapillu lekattechilla muttar laasot ken. Vaapillu hazzakrut mapsiq ben haqqol lehaddabar hechalul betibo shenniqra shopar — en bekak kelum, demin bemino eno chotzetz vahare hu kemo shello haya sham zakrut kelal:

Tzarik shello yehe shum hepseq ben pi hattoqea lehashshopar, lepikak im tzippahu zahab bimqom hannachat happeh kede lenaoto, apillu im hatztzippuy hu beorek hashshopar, im hu miyyad samuk lerosho batztzad haqqatzar — pasul, lepi shehattoqea maknis qetzato bepiv usepato mekassa alayv, venimtza hazzahab chotzetz ben sepato lashshopar. Abal im hatztzippuy hu rachoq mippi hattoqea — kasher. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshello nishtanna qolo mechamat hatztzippuy, o sheeno yodea im nishtanna, demin hassetam lo nishtanna qolo bishbil tzippuy kol shehu, abal im yodea shennishtanna haqqol mechamat hatztzippuy, veap al pi shehashshinnuy hu meat — pasul, lepi sheen qol shopar lebad ella qol shopar veqol dabar acher, dehaynu hatztzippuy:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehatztzippuy hu hosapa al obi hashshopar o al rochbo, abal im hu hosapa al orko, apillu batztzad harachab shello, im natan sham zahab mashshehu al obi hashshopar beinyan shennitarek hashshopar mashshehu — pasul, ap al pi shello nishtanna qolo kelal, mittaam shennitbaer lemala:

Hamtzayyerim bashshopar tzurot kede lenaoto — lo yapeh hen osin, ap al pi sheen kullo metzuppeh bemine hatztziyyurin, lipamim haqqol mishtanneh. Abal muttar lachqoq bashshopar atzmo tzurot kede lenaoto, sheapillu im yishtanneh qolo al yede ken — en bekak kelum, sheen kan qol min dabar acher ella qol hashshopar lebad, vekol haqqolot kesherim bashshopar:
Hirchiq et hashshopar meat mippiv venapach bo vetaqa — lo yatza yede chobato, kevan sheyyesh hepseq meat ben piv lashshopar:

Natan shopar betok shopar, im shama qol penimi lebad, kegon shebbatztzad haqqatzar hu bolet yoter min hachitzon venatan happenimi bepiv vetaqa ubatztzad harachab — en hachitzon bolet yoter min happenimi, ella happenimi bolet yoter o sheshshenehem shavin, denimtza sheen bitqia zo shum taarobot qol min hachitzon ella min happenimi lebad, lepikak yatza yede chobato, sheen kan ella qol shopar echad. Vehu shello nishtanna qolo mechamat shehu natun betok hachitzon, abal im nishtanna qolo, o shehachitzon batztzad harachab shello bolet yoter min happenimi, o shebbatztzad haqqatzar shello hem shavim, deaz i epshar shello shama ella qol shenehem — lo yatza, deqol shopar echad omra tora velo qol shene shoparot:
Kol dabar happosel beyom rishon bashshopar — posel gam beyom sheni, ap al pi sheeno ella middibrehem:

Shopar shel rosh hashshana en mechallelin alayv yom tob, mippene sheyyom tob hu aseh velo taaseh kemo shennitbaer besiman ttz"ch, veen aseh deshopar docheh et lo taaseh vaaseh. Vaapillu bedabar sheissuro eno ella midderabbanan en mechallelin alayv, lepi shechakamim hishvu et dibrehem leshel tora, veheemidu dibrehem lebattel dibre tora besheb veal taaseh:

Ketzad? Haya hashshopar berosh hailan o meeber hannahar veen lo shopar acher ella hu — eno oleh bailan veeno shat al pene hammayim kede lehabio. Veim napal alayv gal shel abanim — asur letaltel haabanim kede littelo. Veen lelek chutz lattechum kede lishmoa qol shopar. Veen tzarik lomar sheen mebiin oto michutz lattechum:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Al yede yisrael, abal al yede nokri muttar laasot kol dabar sheissuro eno ella middibre soperim, kegon laalot bailan ulehabio michutz lattechum vekol kayyotze bazeh. Abal asur lomar lenokri laasot melaka gemura bishbilo. Umikkol maqom, im hannokri asa meatzmo melaka gemura, kegon sheasa shopar beyom tob — muttar litqoa bo, veap al pi sheasa bishbil yisrael, veen chosheshin shemma yomar hayyisrael lannokri laasoto, en chosheshin lazeh ella bedabar sheyyesh hanaa legup adam, abal hammitzvot shello nittenu lahanaat haggup — en chosheshin sheyyaabor abera kede leqayyem hammitzva:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheasa hannokri hashshopar miqqeren shello, deen bo mishshum issur nolad beyom tob, kevan shebben hashshemashot haya haqqeren beyad hannokri, vehannokri lo hiqtza dato millaasot mimmennu shopar, shehare beyado ubirshuto hu laasot mimmennu mah sheyyirtzeh. Abal im asa nokri shopar beyom tob miqqeren shel yisrael, kevan shebben hashshemashot lo haya haqqeren omed laasot mimmennu shopar, shehare lo haya birshuto shel nokri, im ken zeh hashshopar hu nolad beyom tob, veasur hayyisrael letaltelo kede litqoa bo, sheen dochin shebut mippene teqiat shopar. Umikkol maqom, im en sham shopar acher ella hu — muttar litqoa bo, veyesh lismok al hammattirin nolad beyom tob kede shello lebattel mitzvat aseh shel tora:

Im nokri hebi shopar beyom tob michutz lattechum bishbil yisrael, apillu hebio michutz ley"b mil — muttar litqoa bo ap hayyisrael shehuba bishbilo, apillu lehaomerim dechutz ley"b mil yesh issur techumin min hattora, shehare dabar habba michutz lattechum muttar betiltul, veeno asur ella baakila o bahanaa dehaynu lehishtammesh bo kemo shennitbaer besiman tqt"v, vezeh shettoqea bo teqia shel mitzva — en zo chashuba hanaa kelal kemo shennitbaer lemala. Umikkol maqom, tzarik lizzaher shello yetaltelennu chutz led' ammot, veal derek shennitbaer besiman tqt"v, veayyen sham besop hassiman:
Yakol litten betoko mayim o yayin kede letzachtzecho, veen zeh kimtaqqen keli beyom tob. Abal me raglayim ap bechol asur, mippene hakkabod:
